items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: It's like I, I think I did one with Goodman once through those years.

ctx.x: man. I always in front of my own band. I used to do guest spots. I did one with Tommy. You know, like he'd be playing somewhere, and this, when he would play, I'd play a number too. It's like I, I think I did one with Goodman once through those years. I did one with Duke. You know, I guess when I was, I had my own band. But, they'd be playing somewhere and I just went and did a number with them. But, I never worked for nobody else. I always had my own band. I know Duke was asking me about it. He wasn't sure I was…
